title: Berberine Impedes Acute Pancreatitis Development by Suppressing VNN1 Expression and the NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway.
authors: Yang, Jie; Huang, Jianjiang; Zhang, Fang; Wang, Yuyu; Qiu, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱通过抑制VNN1表达和NF-κB通路缓解急性胰腺炎，仅用分子对接初步评估小檗碱-VNN1结合，核心是疾病治疗机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The global incidence of acute pancreatitis (AP) is progressively increasing with rising risk factors such as hyperlipidemia and alcoholism. Berberine (BBR), a quaternary ammonium alkaloid and primary antibacterial agent isolated from the traditional Chinese herb, Coptis chinensis, was investigated for its therapeutic mechanisms in AP. Cell viability was first assessed using the MTT assay at various BBR concentrations, with lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) levels measured in parallel. Then, ELISA quantified inflammatory mediators (caspase-1, IL-1beta, IL-18, TNF-alpha, and IL-6), while western blot analyzed pyroptosis markers (NLRP3 and N-GSDMD). ROS and Fe(2+) levels were detected using commercial kits. Moreover, molecular docking was performed to determine the interaction between BBR and Vanin 1 (VNN1). In vivo experiments were further conducted to assess BBR's role in AP. MTT assays confirmed BBR's non-cytotoxicity at therapeutic concentrations. BBR attenuated caerulein-induced cellular damage and pyroptosis in HPDE6-C7 cells. Molecular docking revealed strong BBR-VNN1 binding affinity (less than -6 kcal/mol). Moreover, VNN1 knockdown attenuated caerulein-induced HPDE6-C7 cell injury and pyroptosis; BBR achieved this effect by inhibiting VNN1 protein expression. BBR suppressed VNN1 expression and NF-kappaB pathway activation (p-p65/p65 ratio). In vivo validation confirmed BBR-mediated AP suppression via VNN1 inhibition. BBR mitigates AP by inhibiting VNN1 expression, thereby suppressing NF-kappaB pathway activation and attenuating caerulein-induced cellular damage and pyroptosis.
abstract_zh: 急性胰腺炎（AP）的全球发病率随着高脂血症和酒精中毒等风险因素的增加而逐渐上升。本研究探讨了小檗碱（Berberine, BBR）——一种从传统中药黄连（Coptis chinensis）中分离出的季铵生物碱及主要抗菌剂——在AP中的治疗机制。首先，通过MTT法在不同BBR浓度下评估细胞活力，并平行测量乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）水平。随后，ELISA定量检测炎症介质（caspase-1、IL-1β、IL-18、TNF-α和IL-6），而western blot分析焦亡标志物（NLRP3和N-GSDMD）。使用商业试剂盒检测ROS和Fe(2+)水平。此外，进行分子对接以确定BBR与Vanin 1（VNN1）之间的相互作用。进一步开展体内实验以评估BBR在AP中的作用。MTT实验确认BBR在治疗浓度下无细胞毒性。BBR减轻了雨蛙素诱导的HPDE6-C7细胞损伤和焦亡。分子对接显示BBR与VNN1具有强结合亲和力（小于-6 kcal/mol）。此外，VNN1敲低减轻了雨蛙素诱导的HPDE6-C7细胞损伤和焦亡；BBR通过抑制VNN1蛋白表达实现此效果。BBR抑制VNN1表达和NF-κB通路激活（p-p65/p65比值）。体内验证确认BBR通过VNN1抑制介导AP的抑制。BBR通过抑制VNN1表达减轻AP，从而抑制NF-κB通路激活并减轻雨蛙素诱导的细胞损伤和焦亡。
